segments.label: Segment 1
segments.vo_line: Meet Akua, she needs to learn about the BoG today.

segments.label: Segment 2
segments.vo_line: she would start by adding a course. Eduwaka reads her syllabus 20,000 times and lays out a plan she can follow at her own pace.
